Defunct designer aliases from DesignLibrary 0.1

Source: R/defunct.R
simple_two_arm_designer.Rd

DesignLibrary 0.1 deprecated these aliases in favor of the designers they called. DesignLibrary 2.0.0 removes them. Each errors with a message naming its replacement, which takes the same arguments.

Usage

simple_two_arm_designer(...)

simple_factorial_designer(...)

simple_iv_designer(...)

simple_spillover_designer(...)

Arguments

...

(optional) Ignored.

Value

Never returns; always raises an error.

Details

RemovedUse instead
simple_two_arm_designer()two_arm_designer()
simple_factorial_designer()two_by_two_designer()
simple_iv_designer()binary_iv_designer()
simple_spillover_designer()spillover_designer()
